bugs_found: apply_fee subtracts the fee twice, returning amount - 2*fee instead of amount - fee
compound_interest/loan_payment silently truncate fractional years/months/compound counts via int(), changing financial results without validation
transfer is not atomic: debit happens before credit, so a failure adding/assigning to account_to.balance can leave balances inconsistent
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal/finite, so floats/NaN/incompatible types can raise late or corrupt accounting assumptions
fx_convert does not validate exchange rates are positive and finite, allowing zero/negative/Infinity rates to produce invalid conversions
